summary: Implemented typed, authorized CRUD for projects, environments, flags, strategies, segments, variants and dependencies, with protected-change acknowledgment, reference-safe deletion, current-token checks and retained audit history.

Replaced unsafe direct persistence with bounded validated JSON, per-write leases, revision/digest conflict detection, isolated request snapshots, atomic file replacement before memory publication, explicit owner/demo setup and preserved original data.
Corrected context evaluation and SDK refresh behavior, fail-closed constraints/variants, scoped metrics batches and limits, HTTP input/origin/host boundaries, and mutable seed isolation.
Rebuilt the administration UI with eight resource editors, explicit in-memory sign-in, typed PATCH drafts, search/pagination, stale/uncertain-write review, one-time token display and mobile layout.
Added nine detailed learning guides, worked defects, exercises/solutions, request trace labs, preserved historical sources/docs, reproducible browser verification and reviewed screenshots.
limits: Loopback local JSON store; no distributed persistence or power-loss guarantee.
No durable mutation receipts, metrics deduplication/automatic pruning, or account recovery.
Basic persisted shape/identity validation; no complete relational migration validation or duplicate-JSON-key rejection.
Chromium desktop/mobile checks, not all-browser or assistive-technology certification.
SDK response JSON has no streaming byte cap; finite Date.parse validation is not strict calendar validation.
One-time token secrets cannot be recovered after a lost creation response; inspect and revoke/recreate as appropriate.
